# LifeWell documentation

> LifeWell keeps the people and moments of your life in one place. Start with yourself, add the people who matter, and keep their stories, your plans and the ordinary details around them. The public guide is at https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com. Last updated: 2026-11-26.

LifeWell is made by the LifeWell team at Zaions. Ahsan Mahmood (aoneahsan) began it after listening to his parents tell the stories of their lives. The app is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or interpret a condition.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/): choose a part of your record.
- [LifeWell web app](https://lifewell.aoneahsan.com/): the live product.
- [Get LifeWell](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/apps): released web and Android surfaces.
- [Features](https://lifewell.aoneahsan.com/features): what each area does before you sign in.
- [Plans](https://lifewell.aoneahsan.com/plans): current public plan information; the signed-in page shows available ways to pay.
- [Privacy](https://lifewell.aoneahsan.com/privacy): where records go and who can see them.
- [Permissions](https://lifewell.aoneahsan.com/permissions): each Android permission and its purpose.

## Your record

People and their connections sit beside memories, everyday plans, sharing, health, mind and life stages. You decide what to enter and what to share. The web app is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Japanese and Urdu.

In Android 3.31.0 or later, you can opt in to approximate background location recording. Rounded points remain on the device for up to 90 days; account sync is a second choice. The 3.31.0 binary is prepared, and its Play publication remains with the owner. The web app has no background location recorder. A limited set of quick logs can wait locally when you choose offline logging, then sync when a connection returns.

## Guides and developer access

- [People](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/domains/people): the people and connections in your record.
- [Memories](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/domains/memories): photos, notes and the moments around them.
- [Calendar and reminders](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/calendar-and-appointments): dates and what you asked to remember.
- [Maps](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/features/maps): the connections view and optional Android location history.
- [Developer API](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/developers/api): account-authorised access.
- [MCP](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/developers/mcp): connect an assistant to an account with permission.
- [Webhooks](https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/developers/webhooks): signed delivery to your own endpoint.
